subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------CUL.SOLD.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-4 (Underlying Philosophical Basis, Level Two), the section where Braxton turns from particular cultures back to the universal philosophical question of how creativity functions cosmically across all of them. (C)AF-CON (affinity convergence) is crossed with CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). The diagram poses: when affinity convergence is taken as a concept (the (c) prefix), what does its relationship to culture solidification actually look like? Besides the main line to CULT-SOLD, AF-CON branches to C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), and to TRS (transition). TRS branches to PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) and to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions); CRTF-D branches to EXP-CONT (expansion condition) and to MT-IMP (multi-implications) → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). Structural argument: affinity convergence opens both onto social-reality-dynamics-via-culture-attitude and onto culture-solidification — a node *between* lived reality and the formed culture. Transition is the active hub from which progressional significance, time-continuum implications, cross-transfer definitions and multi-implications follow.
